+Previous versions of the specification mandated that an illegal-instruction
+exception was raised when an instruction was executed with a reserved dynamic
+rounding mode. This requirement has been weakened to reserved, which matches the
+behavior of static rounding-mode instructions. Raising an illegal-instruction
+exception is a valid behavior when encountering a reserved encoding, so
+implementations compatible with the previous specification are compatible with
+the current specification.
